title: Secretary Rubio’s Travel to Manila for ASEAN Foreign Ministerial Meetings
author: Thomas "Tommy" Pigott, Spokesperson
summary:
Thomas "Tommy" Pigott, Spokesperson

Secretary Rubio’s Travel to Manila for ASEAN Foreign Ministerial Meetings

Press Statement

July 17, 2026

Secretary of State Marco Rubio will travel to Manila, Philippines from July 19-23 to attend the ASEAN Post-Ministerial Conference, the East Asia Summit Foreign Ministers’ Meeting, and the ASEAN Regional Forum Foreign Ministers’ Meeting.  He will also meet with senior government officials from Indo-Pacific countries.

The Secretary’s visit advances a clear U.S. priority: a free and open Indo-Pacific that delivers safety, security, and prosperity for the region and for the American people.

Secretary Rubio will use this trip to demonstrate the tangible results of U.S.-ASEAN partnership and to deepen the United States’ comprehensive partnership with the Philippines.
